SUMMARY: The Discoverer interface in prometheus/discovery must be updated to include a new HealthCheck(ctx context.Context) error method. All service discovery implementations (EC2, Consul, DNS, Kubernetes) must implement this method to provide health status reporting for monitoring systems like Thanos.

FILES:
- prometheus/discovery/discovery.go — Add HealthCheck method to Discoverer interface definition
- prometheus/discovery/aws/ec2.go — Implement HealthCheck for EC2 discovery provider
- prometheus/discovery/consul/consul.go — Implement HealthCheck for Consul discovery provider
- prometheus/discovery/dns/dns.go — Implement HealthCheck for DNS discovery provider
- prometheus/discovery/kubernetes/kubernetes.go — Implement HealthCheck for Kubernetes discovery provider
